children.name: paperlight_memories.txt
children.content:
Things I remember about PAPERLIGHT (writing this down before I forget)

- Lantern Town at night. The music when you first walk out.
- Old Wren, who never had anything useful to say
- the lighthouse. the light that swept over the map
- the bridge that was always missing a texture on my copy
- the fox. Everyone at school said there was a secret fox behind the lighthouse. I never found it. Danny said I made it up.

Halden Softworks closed in 2003. Nobody ever made a sequel.
